slides.title:
Rahu and Ketu
change signs
slides.subtitle: Saturday 5 December · what it means for you

slides.label: What they are
slides.title: Where two paths cross
body: Two points with nothing to see: where the Moon’s path crosses the Sun’s, always exactly opposite each other.
An eclipse can only happen near them.

slides.label: The story · Bhagavata Purana 8.9
slides.title:
The head that
drank the nectar
body: A demon slipped in among the gods and drank the nectar of immortality. The Sun and Moon gave him away.
Vishnu’s disc cut off his head, but the nectar had touched it. The head lived on as Rahu, and still rushes at the Sun and Moon.
slides.closing: The old picture of an eclipse

slides.label: What they stand for
slides.title:
One wants more,
one lets go

items.head: The magician · Rahu
items.line: The Dragon Head: bigness, an open mouth, illusion

items.head: The monk · Ketu
items.line: The Dragon Tail: smallness, narrowness, breaks

slides.closing: Sutram’s reading: where Rahu sits you want more, where Ketu sits you let go

slides.label: Saturday 5 December
slides.title:
One sign back,
for 18 months
items: Rahu in Aquarius · Ketu in Leo
Rahu in Capricorn · Ketu in Cancer
Rahu in Sagittarius · Ketu in Gemini
body: They always walk backward, one sign in about 18 months.
slides.note: Rahu’s mean path, as almanacs like Drik Panchang list it · by the true path the change came on 25 November

slides.label: Find your houses
slides.title: Count from your Moon
body: Your Moon sign is the sign the Moon was in at your birth. Call it 1 and count on. Aries Moon: Capricorn is the 10th, Cancer the 4th.

slides.label: What it does not mean
slides.title: Read it wisely
items: They move about a degree every 19 days. It builds over months.
Your rising sign, your dasha (the graha period you are in) and your birth grahas change the picture.
A harder house asks for care in that part of life.
